ops-bot: Canary launch: Dedicated L80X + H200P are live in ap-southeast-4 (brisbane) on a limited canary. 48h staged rollout, two-week reservation hold for new accounts. :australia:

maya.eng: Nice. Can we get the perf summary and which quant profile to use?

derek.prod: Short: L80X gives ~20% token cost reduction on long contexts with our int8 profile; H200P for lowest p95. Will post bench numbers in #eng-runtime later today.

zoe-sre: Infra: starting with 8 racks. We'll gate on nvlink <0.1% and no kernel OOM surge. Live-patching window 01:00-01:30 UTC tonight.

liam-sales: Please prepare an embargoed note for strategic accounts and temporary pricing uplift for APAC.

anya-support: Support runbook update: tag tickets "brisbane-l80x" and collect model id + seq len if customers report latency regressions.

ops-bot: For reservation exceptions use the capacity request form: https://redwood.company/capacity-request. Reactions: :rocket:
